rainfall is expected.

Western Lincoln County in the piedmont of North Carolina...

heavy rain due to thunderstorms. This  will cause urban and small
stream flooding. Between 1 and 3 inches of rain have fallen.
- Additional rainfall amounts of 1 to 2 inches are expected over

Hickory, Lincolnton, Cherryville, Longview, Valdese, Icard,

enforcement and request they pass this information to the National
Weather Service when you can do so safely.

Turn around, don't drown when encountering flooded roads. Most flood
deaths occur in vehicles.

Be especially cautious at night when it is harder to recognize the
dangers of flooding.

properties.headline: Special Weather Statement issued July 13 at 1:22PM ChST by NWS Tiyan GU
properties.description:
Latest satellite-derived ocean surface wind data shows a strong burst
of west to southwest winds. These stronger winds will continue
around Yap and Palau, lasting through Tuesday. Gusts up to gale
force, or 35 kt, can be expected at both Yap and Palau. Seas will
build in response to the increasing winds with hazardous conditions
expected at Yap, making inter-island travel dangerous, especially to
small craft.

Regional weather continues to be dominated by the circulation, known
as 97W, which sits just northwest of Yap near 11N137E. This
circulation, still showing a broad wind field, continues to become
better organized and is now the subject of a Tropical Cyclone
Formation Alert by the Joint Typhoon Warning Center. This means that
the formation of a tropical depression is likely within 24 hours. As
97W lifts northward, winds and seas will gradually subside, first
across Palau, then across western Yap State.

Residents and mariners should keep up to date with the latest
forecasts for Yap and Palau by visiting weather.gov/gum or seeking
updated information from local Weather Service Offices and emergency
managers.

properties.description:
The Colorado Department of Public Health and Environment has
issued the following...

WHAT...Air Quality Health Advisory for Wildfire Smoke.

WHERE...Southwest Pueblo County. Locations include, but are not
limited to Beulah and Rye.

WHEN...900 AM Sunday July 12 to 900 AM Monday July 13

IMPACTS...Moderate to heavy smoke from the Aspen Acres Fire is
possible in southwest Pueblo County until at least Monday morning.

HEALTH INFORMATION...Public Health Recommendations: If smoke is
thick or becomes thick in your neighborhood you may want to remain
indoors. This is especially true for those with heart disease,
respiratory illnesses, the very young, and older adults. Consider
limiting outdoor activity when moderate to heavy smoke is present.
Consider relocating temporarily if smoke is present indoors and is
making you ill. If visibility is less than 5 miles in smoke in
your neighborhood, smoke has reached levels that are unhealthy.
properties.note: Non-Weather Emergency Message. Not sent to IPAWS.
